_about: Card mastery quests (backend/economy/veterans.js, UI.veteran_box): three per card, done in order, each earning the next veteran frame (bronze Seasoned, chrome Battle-Scarred, gold Street Legend). A card's set goes by what it is (veterans.js questKind / UI.veteran_kind): leader; a Hustle / Ambush / Equip ('card'); a Striver with a next level; a Heavy; a character with effects ('effects'); any other character. stat: plays (matches it was played in), wins (matches won with it played), kos / downs / fights (enemy characters it KO'd / Downed / both, in its attacks), direct (Morale damage of its direct attacks), effects (times its effects did something), promotes (times it PROMOTED), awakens (a leader's Awakenings).

heavy.text: Deal 2500 Morale damage with its direct attacks

effects.text: Down or KO 20 enemy characters with it

character.text: Down or KO 5 enemy characters with it

leader.text: Win 10 matches with it leading your deck
Win 30 matches with it leading your deck
